title: Reading an audited statement into the CMA heads
status: Set by Claude at the owner's request (U1, D-UX-48): an AI only points to the line and the number on it where the statement prints each head; the program copies the digits, adds a head printed on several lines, applies the units and checks the sums against the totals the statement prints. Nothing counts until the borrower ticks it. Text PDFs only; a scanned one is asked to be typed.

checks.what: Liabilities add up to the total printed
Assets add up to the total printed
The profit worked from the heads ties to the profit printed

rounding: A sum may differ from the printed total by half a printed unit for each figure added (a statement in lakh with two decimals rounds each figure to Rs. 500), and still tie: the difference is shown

where.sales: Revenue from operations, net of GST (not the total income)
where.materials: Cost of materials consumed, purchases of stock-in-trade and the change in inventories, each line pointed: the program adds them
where.otherDirect: Manufacturing or direct expenses: wages, power and fuel, stores, job work
where.employees: Employee benefits expense (salaries, staff welfare), unless wages are already in the direct expenses
where.sga: Other expenses: selling, administration and the rest
where.wcInterest: Interest on cash credit, overdraft or other working-capital loans, from the note to finance costs
where.tlInterest: Interest on term loans and other finance costs, from the note to finance costs
where.tax: Current tax and deferred tax, each line pointed
where.drawings: Dividend paid, or the partners' or proprietor's drawings
where.capital: Share capital, or the partners' or proprietor's capital
where.reserves: Reserves and surplus, the closing figure
where.promoterLoans: Unsecured loans from directors, partners, the proprietor or their relatives
where.termLoans: Term loans from banks and others: the non-current part and the current maturities, each line pointed
where.tlDue12: Current maturities of long-term debt, the part due within 12 months
where.bankWc: Cash credit, overdraft or working-capital demand loans from banks
where.otherCl: Other current liabilities and short-term provisions, each line pointed, without the current maturities of term loans
where.netBlock: Property, plant and equipment (and intangible assets), net of depreciation
where.nonCurrent: Non-current investments, long-term loans and advances, other non-current assets
where.cash: Cash and cash equivalents and other bank balances
where.otherCa: Short-term loans and advances and other current assets

totals.liabilities: Total equity and liabilities (or total of the liabilities side)
totals.profit: Profit (or loss) for the year, after tax
